# Rules of this knowledge base

`charter.yaml` declares the kinds of note this knowledge base holds, their fields and where they live. This file explains it; `charter validate` enforces it.

## Working here

Whoever edits a note here, a person or a tool, follows this workflow:

1. Read these rules before creating or editing any note.
2. Create a note with the `charter new` command given for each kind: it places, names and fills in the note. Run `charter describe KIND` for the rules of one kind.
3. After each edit, run `charter validate --file PATH` and fix what it reports before moving on.
4. Before changing a fact other notes may depend on, run `charter sweep` to find them.
5. Never change `charter.yaml` to make a note pass. If the contract itself seems wrong, stop and tell the human: only the human decides to change it, by running Evolve, the charter skill for the deliberate change of a contract.
6. Never add a `Charter-Allow:` trailer to a commit message unless the human explicitly asks for one: overriding an edit policy is their decision.
7. This contract wins over any other guidance about how a document should look or be organised.

# Kinds

## `grower`

A person who tends plots in the garden.

- Path: `notes/Growers/{title}.md`.
- Template: `notes/Templates/Grower.md`.
- Undeclared fields: an error.

Create one with:

```
charter new grower "TITLE"
```

### Fields

| Field | Required | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | yes | names the kind: always `grower` |  |
| `title` | yes | a string; matches its part of the file name | The grower's name. |
| `joined` | yes | a date (YYYY-MM-DD); `charter new` fills in today's date |  |

### Body outline

- `# {{title}}`: what this grower looks after and when they are around
- `## Plots`
- `## Notes` (optional)

## `plot`

A bed or container where crops are grown.

- Path: `notes/Plots/{title}.md`.
- Template: `notes/Templates/Plot.md`.
- Undeclared fields: an error.

Create one with:

```
charter new plot "TITLE"
```

### Fields

| Field | Required | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | yes | names the kind: always `plot` |  |
| `title` | yes | a string; matches its part of the file name | The plot's name. |
| `sun` | yes | a string, one of `full`, `partial`, `shade`; default `full` |  |
| `steward` | no | a link, linking to `grower` |  |
| `area_m2` | no | a number, from 0.5 to 200 |  |

### Body outline

- `# {{title}}`: where the plot is and what the soil is like
- `## Soil`
- `## Rotation` (optional)

## `crop`

A plant the garden grows, and what it needs.

- Path: `notes/Crops/{title}.md`.
- Template: `notes/Templates/Crop.md`.
- Undeclared fields: an error.
- Variants, each with its own section: a note with these values is the variant, not the plain kind.
  - `crop/perennial`: `lifecycle` is `perennial`.

Create one with:

```
charter new crop "TITLE" --set season=SEASON --set plot=PLOT
```

A value that selects a variant creates that variant instead: use the variant's own command.

### Fields

| Field | Required | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | yes | names the kind: always `crop` |  |
| `title` | yes | a string; matches its part of the file name | The crop's common name. |
| `lifecycle` | yes | a string, one of `annual`, `perennial`; `perennial` makes it `crop/perennial`; default `annual` |  |
| `season` | yes | a string, one of `spring`, `summer`, `autumn`, `winter` |  |
| `stage` | yes | a string, one of `planned`, `sown`, `growing`, `harvested`, `failed`; default `planned` |  |
| `plot` | yes | a link, linking to `plot` |  |
| `companions` | no | a list, each item a link, linking to `crop` |  |
| `sown` | no | a date (YYYY-MM-DD); allowed only when `stage` is `sown` or `growing` or `harvested` |  |
| `reason` | when `stage` is `failed` | a string |  |
| `tags` | no | a list, each item a string |  |

### Body outline

- `# {{title}}`: why the garden grows this and what it likes
- `## Sowing`
- `## Care`
- `## Harvest notes` (optional)

## `crop/perennial`

A plant the garden grows, and what it needs.

- Variant of `crop`: a `crop` note is this variant when `lifecycle` is `perennial`.
- Path: `notes/Crops/Perennials/{title}.md`.
- Template: `notes/Templates/Perennial.md`.
- Undeclared fields: an error.

Create one with:

```
charter new crop/perennial "TITLE" --set season=SEASON --set plot=PLOT --set years_to_harvest=YEARS_TO_HARVEST
```

### Fields

| Field | Required | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | yes | names the kind: always `crop` |  |
| `title` | yes | a string; matches its part of the file name | The crop's common name. |
| `lifecycle` | yes | always `perennial`, which makes the note this variant |  |
| `season` | yes | a string, one of `spring`, `summer`, `autumn`, `winter` |  |
| `stage` | yes | a string, one of `planned`, `sown`, `growing`, `harvested`, `failed`; default `planned` |  |
| `plot` | yes | a link, linking to `plot` |  |
| `companions` | no | a list, each item a link, linking to `crop` |  |
| `sown` | no | a date (YYYY-MM-DD); allowed only when `stage` is `sown` or `growing` or `harvested` |  |
| `reason` | when `stage` is `failed` | a string |  |
| `tags` | no | a list, each item a string |  |
| `years_to_harvest` | yes | an integer, from 1 to 30 |  |

### Body outline

- `# {{title}}`: why the garden grows this and what it likes
- `## Planting`
- `## Care`
- `## Seasons` (repeat)

## `entry`

A dated line in the garden journal.

- Path: `notes/Journal/{id} {title}.md`.
- Template: `notes/Templates/Entry.md`.
- Undeclared fields: an error.
- All `entry` notes together: `id` values run without gaps.

Create one with:

```
charter new entry "TITLE"
```

### Fields

| Field | Required | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | yes | names the kind: always `entry` |  |
| `id` | yes | an integer; unique among `entry` notes; `charter new` fills in the next free value |  |
| `title` | yes | a string |  |
| `date` | yes | a date (YYYY-MM-DD); `charter new` fills in today's date |  |
| `crop` | no | a link, linking to `crop` |  |

### Body outline

- `# {{title}}`: what happened, in a sentence or two
- `## What happened`
- `## Follow-up` (optional)

# Path policies

Globs are relative to the knowledge-base root, `notes`; the paths above are relative to the directory holding charter.yaml. Each key takes its value from the most specific matching glob.

| Glob | Policy |
|---|---|
| `Templates/**` | ignored: not notes, never validated |
| `Journal/**` | only kinds `entry`; create-only: new files may be added; existing files may not change or be deleted; left out of `charter sweep` results |
| `Plots/**` | only kinds `plot` |
| `Growers/**` | only kinds `grower` |
